advertisers.name: Enneagram MBA
advertisers.notes: Podcast + team workshops + budget DIY workshop kit. Direct competitor on workshop/kit model.

advertisers.name: RLim Leadership Coaching (Richard Lim)
advertisers.notes: 1:1 executive/leadership coach, 20+ yrs, targets Christian executives and senior leaders. Active video ad running lead-magnet funnel (free guide).

advertisers.name: Vanguard XXI
advertisers.notes: ICF-accredited coach certification academy + 1:1 executive coaching for senior leaders/teams. Closest structural match to our own certify-coaches model, not just a coaching service.

advertisers.name: Center for Executive Coaching
advertisers.notes: ICF-aligned executive coaching certification program ('CEC Core Certification'). Certification-business competitor, same funnel shape as our coach-cert model.

advertisers.name: EntreLeadership
advertisers.notes: Dave Ramsey's Ramsey Solutions offers 1:1 executive coaching for business owners. Well-funded, well-known brand — useful benchmark for production quality and offer structure.

advertisers.name: Marlo Lyons Coaching
advertisers.notes: 1:1 executive/leadership coach, active organic-style video ads on C-suite transitions and executive credibility. Real practitioner, running multiple ad variations.

advertisers.name: Ed Rush / God Talks Coaching Certification
advertisers.notes: Coach certification funnel targeting people who want to become executive coaches (faith-integration angle). Certification-business competitor, not a direct coaching-client competitor.

advertisers.name: Brendon Burchard - GrowthDay
advertisers.notes: Large coach-training funnel ('3-Day Coaching Training') aimed at people building a coaching business. Certification/training-business competitor at much bigger scale — useful for funnel/offer benchmarking.

advertisers.name: The COO Solution
advertisers.notes: Direct fractional COO placement for founder-led companies $1M-$15M revenue. Running multiple active ad variations — clearly meaningful ad spend.

advertisers.name: On Call COO (Melissa Franks)
advertisers.notes: Direct-to-market fractional COO service, consistent 'The RIGHT Fractional COO can help' messaging across several active ads.

advertisers.name: Run Like Clockwork
advertisers.notes: Certifies and directories 'Certified Fractional COOs' trained in the Clockwork methodology. Certification + marketplace model, not a single practitioner.

advertisers.name: Double U Advisors (Jamie L. Smith)
advertisers.notes: $47 'Executive to Fractional Leader Blueprint' — info-product tripwire teaching corporate execs to launch a fractional COO/CFO/CMO practice. Closest business-model match to our own StackOS tripwire approach; several active ad variations.

advertisers.name: Sound Cove Leadership Institute
advertisers.notes: Positions/trains executives 45-60 to build a fractional leadership practice ('Fix your Fractional Positioning'). Training/positioning competitor rather than a placement service.

notes: Browser-based ingestion (current approach): only the advertiser's name is required. Claude searches facebook.com/ads/library by name/page directly — no Meta Page ID, no Developer account, no API token needed.
Add advertisers under the right category — the frontend groups and tags by category, so an advertiser in the wrong bucket will get mis-sorted, not just mislabeled.
A 'website' field helps disambiguate when a name search returns multiple similarly-named advertisers.
